name: Zaraasuchus
sum: Zaraasuchus is a gobiosuchid crocodyliform with strongly developed armour from the Late Cretaceous of the Gobi Desert, Mongolia.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: IGM 100/1321, the posterior skull and lower jaws articulated with cervical vertebrae, forelimb elements and osteoderms (Red Beds of Zos Canyon, Mongolia).
biology: It had four rows of dorsal osteoderms sutured laterally, each with a sharp spike and rugose ridges.
author: Pol and Norell 2004

sources.text: D. Pol and M. A. Norell. 2004. A new gobiosuchid crocodyliform taxon from the Cretaceous of Mongolia. American Museum Novitates 3458:1-31
